* Develop and execute **stakeholder and communication management plans**, ensuring stakeholder expectations, project updates, decisions, and changes are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.
* Build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across functions and demonstrate a solid understanding of relevant quality systems.
* Demonstrate **strong emotional intelligence**, remaining calm under pressure and effectively navigating conflict.
* Drive results in a fast-paced environment, effectively managing demanding timelines and stepping up to take additional responsibility when needed.
* Lead and motivate teams by aligning the right people to the right tasks, maintaining team morale, and recognizing individual and team contributions.
* **Influence without direct authority**, building alignment and collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
* Incorporate end-user feedback throughout the project lifecycle and clearly communicate changes, updates, and decisions to key stakeholders.
* Connect project objectives to **broader organizational goals** and prioritize activities and schedules accordingly.
* Keep the **customer at the heart of decision-making**.
* Exercise sound judgment, balancing benefits and risks to make effective decisions, even in ambiguous situations.
* Demonstrate a **growth mindset**, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing environments.
* Take on additional role-specific technical responsibilities, knowledge, or capabilities as required by the local hiring manager.

**Required Skills:**  

* BS or equivalent and 4+ years of work experience

  
**Preferred Qualifications :**  

* PMP or equivalent preferred

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Manager – Projects and EPC
description:

From renewable energy and automotive production to water treatment plants and chemical systems, our advanced electronic sensors and automation components enable smooth and safe operations around the globe.
  
  
We take pride in fostering a supportive and collaborative workplace culture, where employees feel connected and valued - much like a close-knit family. As we continue to grow, we are excited to welcome a new team member for the following position:

Manager – Projects and EPC  

**Job Tittle: Manager – Projects and EPC**

**Role Purpose**

**Drive project business development and sales across India by building strong relationships with EPC companies, consultants, major end users and project stakeholders. Identify upcoming projects and tenders, ensure Pepperl & Fuchs products and technologies are approved and specified, coordinate with internal teams, and support successful project conversion and execution.**

**Major Accountabilities**

* **Ensure timely availability of project intelligence and secure participation of Pepperl & Fuchs in upcoming government and private-sector project tenders across India, with appropriate approvals and correct product and technology identification.**
* **Strengthen engagement with EPC companies, consultants and major end users to drive product approvals, project access, business opportunities and sustainable customer relationships.**

**Key Performance Indicators**

* **Achieve approval and specification of Pepper & Fuchs products and technologies across EPC companies in India, while successfully resolving customer and consultant queries related to products, company approvals and manufacturing locations.**
* **Improve advance project information, project conversion success and business opportunities, particularly across the chemical, oil and gas sectors in India.**

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Project Identification & Intelligence: Identify upcoming projects, expansions, tenders and investment opportunities in the oil, gas, chemical, petrochemical and related industries, while maintaining accurate project information.**
* **EPC, Consultant & End-User Engagement: Develop and maintain strong relationships with EPC contractors, consultants and project stakeholders to enhance project access and business opportunities.**
* **Product Approval & Specification: Secure approval and inclusion of Pepperl & Fuchs products and technologies in customer specifications, approved vendor lists, tender documents and project requirements.**
* **Project Sales Management: Manage project sales activities from opportunity identification and technical discussions through tendering, quotation, negotiation, order placement and project execution.**
* **Technical & Commercial Coordination: Coordinate with sales, product management, technical, factory and service teams to recommend solutions, obtain approvals, prepare bids and resolve customer queries, while monitoring project progress, competition and forecasts.**

**Job Specific Requirements**

* **Education: BE/B.Tech in Instrumentation or an equivalent qualification.**
* **Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in sales and project working with EPC companies and consultants.**
* **Languages: Proficiency in English, Hindi and any other regional language of India.**
* **Software Skills: Working knowledge of MS Office tools, ERP and CRM systems.**
* **Technical Knowledge: Good knowledge of project instrumentation, Signal handling control room technology and explosion protection techniques.**

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project ManagerJob Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Project Manager** to lead and manage software development projects from planning through delivery. The ideal candidate should have a strong technical understanding, excellent project management skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with development, QA, DevOps, product, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, manage, and deliver software projects within defined **scope, timeline, and budget**.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, QA engineers, DevOps, and stakeholders.
* Define project requirements, milestones, deliverables, and timelines.
* Break projects into tasks and assign responsibilities to team members.
* Track project progress, identify risks, and resolve blockers.
* Conduct regular **stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives**.
* Communicate project status, progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.
* Manage technical dependencies and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
* Work closely with developers to understand technical challenges and requirements.
* Ensure projects follow development, testing, security, and deployment processes.
* Manage scope changes and prioritize tasks based on business requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve development and project delivery processes.
* Maintain project documentation, timelines, reports, and technical specifications.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **software development lifecycle (SDLC)**.
* Experience with **Agile/Scrum** methodologies.
* Good understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, cloud, and software architecture.
* Experience with project management tools such as **Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar**.
* Strong communication, leadership, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, risk management, and resource management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Good to Have

* Technical background in **JavaScript, Node.js, React, Python, Java**, or similar technologies.
* Experience with **AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, CI/CD**, and DevOps workflows.
* Experience managing API integrations, AI projects, or cloud\-based applications.
* Familiarity with Git and software release management.
* PMP, Scrum Master, or other relevant project management certification.

Experience

**1–7 years** of experience in technical project management, software development, or a related field, with experience managing software development teams.

What We’re Looking For

A technically strong and organized project manager who can bridge the gap between **business requirements and technical execution**, keep teams aligned, proactively manage risks, and ensure successful project delivery.
